regions.full_page: Promoter Miss K (of Bayonne N.J . ) S.M. A. writes from Roosevelt School Bayonne, N.J ." ..... and Chas D- of Bayonne for one year. I think it most advisable for this last one to be enrolled at once and not wait till meeting Sunday. He is out on probation." (Envolved in case of theft) Next day same promoter writes, "Charles D. ---- starting to make restitution: promises to make good in short time for everything." M. Bonner tells him though she might have him in Jail, that prayers are being offered for his reform. Tears came into his eyes as he himself admitted that a strange in- fluence has come over him. He has promised to give up drinking and bad company". Relatives seemed to have lost hopes in the possibility of his reform. "Father, what influence prayers have over a person!"
